sources.note: An edited documentary record of events from March 1927 to November 1956. Added in step 6 because the Timeline Wall needs dated events, with pages to cite, that volumes 1 and 7 do not record. Its frontispiece is kept as a plate: its caption gives the dates of birth and death, which no numbered page does.

sources.rights: Proceedings of the Constituent Assembly of India, a public record. Transcription and paragraph numbering by the Centre for Law and Policy Research.

sources.title: Constitution of India, Article 17: Abolition of Untouchability
sources.creator: Constituent Assembly of India
sources.rights: Text of the Constitution of India, a public document. Annotation and drafting history by the Centre for Law and Policy Research.
sources.note: Carries the drafting history: Article 17 (1950) was Draft Article 11 (1948), debated 29 November 1948. That link is the seed of the provenance graph in step 7. Slugs for the other articles Ambedkar shaped are not discoverable from an index page and are deferred to step 7.
